notes.title: Hidden Cats 5: Magic Tree is coming soon. 🐾😸 Add to wishlist!😻
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921850/HIDDEN_CATS_5_Magic_Tree/?curator_clanid=40622694"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302546/50ec40188388b239666975a0ba05bd4716996b6c.png"][/img][/p][p]For cats lovers, the sequel to the Hidden Cats 5: Magic Tree game series is coming soon. Add it to your wishlist so you don't miss the game's release! You will have to find cleverly cats hiding in the foliage of the magical tree and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-attracting picture, cute cats and nice atmospheric music are waiting for you.[/p]
